campaigns.name: BP · Shopping — Brand/Model
campaigns.rationale: Owns ALL product-specific traffic per Trevor's direction. Destination URLs come from the feed, so every click lands on a product page. Budget raised from $35 now that it absorbs the brand/product intent formerly handled by Search.

campaigns.name: BP · PMax — Outdoor Kitchens
campaigns.rationale: Focused on outdoor kitchens -- the one asset group with complete image coverage from existing account assets. 218 SKUs. Product ads route to product pages via the feed; other placements go to the custom kitchen funnel.

campaigns.name: BP RT · Display Remarketing
campaigns.rationale: RETAINED. Best CPA in the account -- 7 conversions at $21 on $147/mo, budget-starved at $5/day.

required_negatives.note: Restaurant-contamination negatives are no longer needed -- the grill-brand SKAGs that required them were dropped. Universal negative list still applies (negative_keywords/betterpatio.json).

landing_page_policy.model: PMax + Shopping -> product pages (from feed). Search -> custom kitchen funnel. Retargeting -> retained. Nothing points at collections.
landing_page_policy.funnel_url_source: VERIFIED — live final URL on 'Build Your Own Outdoor Kitchen Campaign', the account's only converting campaign.
landing_page_policy.evidence_collections_dont_convert: 3 enabled Search campaigns point exclusively at collection pages and produced ZERO conversions on $834.81/mo combined: BP S1 Categories Search ($231.15), BP S2 Brands Search ($441.37), BP S3 Brands Expansion ($162.29).
landing_page_policy.dropped_grill_skags: blaze grill / bull grill / fire magic grill / coyote gas grill removed from Search. They are product-specific intent, which Shopping and PMax now own with real product listings. Keeping them in Search would compete with our own Shopping ads on the same queries.

cutover_plan.critical: The account currently has 12 ENABLED campaigns totalling $392/day in budget capacity. Launching the new build without pausing them would leave the account at $542/day and put new campaigns in direct competition with old ones on the same keywords and the same product feed.
cutover_plan.rule: Every campaign below is paused in the SAME operation that enables its replacement. Never both live at once.

disposition.campaign: Build Your Own Outdoor Kitchen Campaign
disposition.note: The account's only converting Search campaign, so this is the one carrying real risk. The replacement targets the SAME funnel with proper SKAG structure, so running both would mean bidding against ourselves on identical kitchen terms. If Trevor prefers caution, the alternative is to leave this live for 2 weeks and launch the SKAG campaign alongside at reduced budget -- accepting some self-competition in exchange for not interrupting the one thing that works.
